Claim 26 (Currently Amended): A non-aqueous composition comprising: a therapeutically effective amount of a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) selected from the group consisting of propionic acid NSAIDs, acetic acid NSAIDs, and salicylic acid NSAIDs, said NSAID being admixed as a powder directly in a non-aqueous carrier wherein the non-aqueous carrier comprises a bio-compatible oil and from 20 wt.% to 80 wt.% phosphatidylcholine; the NSAID to non-aqueous carrier weight ratio is about 5:1 to about 1:5; wherein the phosphatidylcholine is present in an amount sufficient to reduce NSAID-associated gastro-intestinal ulceration and bleeding, and therapeutic activity of the NSAID for treatment of tissue inflammation, pain and fever is preserved.

Claim 27 (Previously Submitted): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the non-aqueous carrier comprises from 20 wt.% to 60 wt.% phosphatidylcholine.

Claim 28 (Cancelled)

Claim 29 (Previously Submitted): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the weight ratio of NSAID to non-aqueous carrier is about 2:1 to about 1:2.

Claim 30 (Previously Submitted): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the NSAID is a salicylic acid NSAID.

Claim 31 (Previously Submitted): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the NSAID is salicylate, ibuprofen, ketoprofen, naproxen, oxaprozin, diclofenac, etodolac, indomethacin, ketorolac, aspirin, or combinations thereof.

Claim 32 (Previously Submitted): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the NSAID is aspirin, salicylate, diclofenac, naproxen, ibuprofen, indomethacin, or combinations thereof.

Claim 33 (Currently Amended): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the bio-compatible oil comprises __lecithin, essential oil, vegetable oil, animal oils, vitamin A, vitamin D, vitamin E, fish oil, or mixtures and combinations thereof__.

Claim 34 (Previously Submitted): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 33, wherein the vegetable oil is peanut oil, canola oil, avocado oil, safflower oil, olive oil, corn oil, soy bean oil, sesame oil, or mixtures and combinations thereof.

Claim 36 (Cancelled)

Claim 39 (Previously Submitted): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the composition does not include a solvent.

Claim 40 (Previously Submitted): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the composition does not include methanol, ethanol, or chloroform.

Claim 42 (Previously Submitted): The non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition of claim 41 comprising from 10 wt % to 60 wt% phosphatidylcholine.
